subject: Capacity mode preference — follow-up & numbers
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Alex Han <alex.han@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity mode preference — follow-up & numbers

Hi Alex — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and a couple of clarifying questions so we can recommend the right deployment path (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private).

Call recap (high level)
- App: BlueWave chat assistant (real-time product support)
- Model target: open 13B family (you mentioned Meta Llama-variant)
- Current production-ish traffic: typical steady-state ~20 QPS, daytime peak bursts up to 300–400 QPS for short windows (~5–15 min)
- Payload: ~120 tokens in, ~220 tokens out average (per request)
- Latency goals you called out: p95 <= 100ms, p99 ideally <= 250ms (please confirm)

Questions for you (so we size correctly)
1) Are the burst windows predictable (e.g., scheduled campaigns) or truly traffic-driven spikes?
2) Does BlueWave need data to stay in your VPC (sensitive PII) or can you accept hosted with our controls?
3) Any procurement constraints (contract start date / PO timing)?

What we’ll do next
- Connor will run a quick throughput/latency estimate and propose a minimal Dedicated sizing and a Hosted POC profile.
- We’ll surface a ballpark cost delta (hosted vs dedicated) for the expected sustained throughput + headroom.
- If you want, we can set up a 2-week hosted POC with traffic replay to validate p95/p99.

Attached: placeholder sheet to capture the numbers if you want to drop additional rows (BlueWave_latency_requirements.xlsx).

Thanks — cc’ing Rishi for commercial alignment.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0143

--
Redwood Inference — production-first inference for teams
From: Alex Han <alex.han@bluewave.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: BlueWave AI Procurement <procurement@bluewave.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity mode preference — follow-up & numbers

Hi Sofia — thanks for the summary, that’s accurate. A few clarifications and added context below.

Traffic and SLOs
- Steady-state: 18–25 QPS (day-to-day)
- Peak: typically 250–400 QPS for product launches or marketing pushes; bursts usually last 5–20 minutes and are mostly traffic-driven (we can provide past 90 days of telemetry)
- Latency target: p95 <= 100ms, p99 <= 220–250ms (we’ll tolerate occasional misses but want predictability)

Data / Security
- BlueWave handles support transcripts; most are non-sensitive but some sessions include customer-identifying data. For now we prefer hosted with SOC2 + contract controls, but if Private (VPC/on-prem) is required later, we’ll escalate.

Procurement
- We’d like a 30-day hosted POC to validate latency before committing to Dedicated. If POC shows we can’t hit p99 targets, we will consider Dedicated sizing. Procurement needs a ballpark monthly cost for Dedicated (baseline) to flag to finance; anything +/-20% is fine for now.

Attached: our simple traffic export (BlueWave-traffic-matrix.csv). I’ll drop a replay sample once we agree on the POC window.

Thanks,
Alex Han
Head of Platform — BlueWave AI
alex.han@bluewave.ai
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Han <alex.han@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity mode preference — follow-up & numbers

Thanks for the detail, Alex — good data to work with. Below are pragmatic recommendations and a short POC plan so you can validate without a large commitment.

Quick recommendation (short answer) - Start with a 2-week Hosted POC running production traffic replay with a small steady reservation and burst capacity; if p99 misses are frequent under realistic burst behavior, move to Dedicated.

Why: Hosted lets you validate work-in-progress model behavior, prompt engineering, and caching strategies quickly. Dedicated provides the best headroom and predictable unit economics for sustained throughput, but it is a larger upfront commitment + procurement.

Sizing notes (back-of-envelope for a 13B family) - Single A100 80GB (TF32 / optimized kernels) baseline: ~55–70 synchronous QPS at short context (<1k tokens) for generation workloads. Your average tokens (in+out ~340) push effective throughput down; assume ~40–50 QPS per A100 for realistic end-to-end latency.
- For steady 25 QPS: 1 GPU is sufficient for headroom on steady state.
- For sustained 250–400 QPS bursts: you’ll want 6–10x that baseline depending on how much headroom you want and how well batching can be applied. Conservative Dedicated baseline: 4x A100-80GB to cover repeated short bursts with autoscale stepping.

Hybrid / options - Hosted POC config: reserve 1 GPU-equivalent (hosted) + burst policy to allow up to 6 concurrent nodes for short windows; enable KV prefix caching for repeated prompts; enable continuous batching (we’ll configure as aggressive-latency-aware).
- Dedicated baseline estimate: 4x A100-80GB reserved for production (with autoscale to 8 during predictable campaigns). We can refine after we run a replay.

Ballpark commercial delta (very rough)
- Hosted POC: usage only for 2 weeks — we’ll provide dev credits to offset validation cost.
- Dedicated baseline (monthly committed): estimate range $XXk–$YYk/month for 4 A100 equivalent reservation (we’ll provide a precise number after you confirm traffic percentiles + retention). Rishi will follow up with a firm commercial.

POC plan and next steps
1) BlueWave shares a 48–72h traffic replay sample (sanitized or test tokenized replay).
2) Redwood deploys a hosted POC cluster and runs replay during a 2-week window; we measure p95/p99 and token costs.
3) Meet at end of POC to review telemetry and decide Dedicated sizing (if needed).

I’ve attached a quick CSV with our initial performance estimate for your traffic export (redwood_performance_estimate.csv). If you want, we can schedule a short SE working session next week to walk the replay pipeline and KV tuning.

—Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0119

Sofia / Connor — this all sounds good. We’re happy to proceed with the 2-week hosted POC. Next items from our side:
- I’ll share a sanitized 72h replay (deliverable by Mon 6/15).
- Procurement asked for a Dedicated baseline monthly estimate to put a hold in finance: please send a ballpark for the 4x A100-80GB baseline so we can flag it internally (email is fine).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — look forward to the replay.

Best,
Alex

Team recommended Hosted POC 2-week replay followed by Dedicated sizing (4x A100 baseline). Action items: BlueWave to share 72h replay, Redwood to provide Dedicated ballpark and confirm POC credits and schedule.
